description: Whole-account budget status: pass a daily budget (required) and optionally weekly and monthly ones. For each: spend so far, percent used, projected end-of-period spend at the current hourly burn rate, hours left before the budget runs out, and a status of OK (<80%), WARNING (80–99%) or OVER BUDGET. Covers all providers and projects; to check a budget for one project or provider, use tokmeter_budget. Nothing is stored or scheduled: it reports on demand.
name: tokmeter_budget_alert
